shots.scene_description: HAND-DRAWN 2D URBAN INDIE CARTOON WITH MUTED WATERCOLOR WASHES, lean average-height build with reserved posture, long oval face, straight narrow nose, heavy-lidded eyes, short tousled dark hair — wide 16:9 view of a modest independent used-car lot, the Protagonist inspecting an unremarkable compact sedan, wearing a pale-grey sweatshirt, olive chinos, and white sneakers
shots.wardrobe_override: pale-grey sweatshirt, olive chinos, and white sneakers

shots.text: Used,
shots.edit_instruction: USED COMPACT SEDAN — hard cut to a front three-quarter close view — faint paint wear, an older inspection sticker, and ordinary wheel covers establish its age without drama

shots.text: paid in cash,
shots.edit_instruction: PAYMENT COUNTER — cut to an overhead insert — the Protagonist slides a cashier's check and receives the keys, with no financing forms anywhere in frame

shots.text: nothing anyone would photograph.
shots.edit_instruction: ORDINARY COMPACT CAR — cut to a low curbside profile that deliberately denies glamour — flat practical bodywork sits beneath washed-out daylight while other shoppers walk past without looking

shots.text: Nobody cheers when you pull it into the driveway.
shots.edit_instruction: DRIVEWAY ARRIVAL — new wide view from inside the quiet house looking outward — the compact sedan rolls into place while empty windows and an undisturbed street offer no audience
shots.action: parks the car in the driveway

shots.text: Nobody needs to.
shots.edit_instruction: HAND-DRAWN 2D URBAN INDIE CARTOON WITH MUTED WATERCOLOR WASHES, heavy-lidded eyes and straight narrow nose — cut to a passenger-side medium shot — the Protagonist switches off the engine and allows a small private exhale

shots.text: Because the real question was never why you kept driving that Corolla.
shots.edit_instruction: OLD COROLLA KEY — cut to a close insert in his open palm beside the new key — the worn old key carries fifteen years of use while the new one remains visually plain
shots.action: compares the old and new keys

shots.text: The real question was always how much of your one life you were willing to spend trying to look successful
shots.edit_instruction: DRIVEWAY AND STREET — lateral medium-wide shot as the Protagonist leaves the plain sedan and walks toward his house; ghosted outlines of luxury vehicles and admiring crowds briefly form behind him, then thin away

shots.text: before you actually were.
shots.edit_instruction: HAND-DRAWN 2D URBAN INDIE CARTOON WITH MUTED WATERCOLOR WASHES, long oval face and softened heavy-lidded eyes — new interior angle from the darkened entryway — he crosses the threshold while the paid-off car remains small outside

shots.text: Some people answer that question with a lease.
shots.scene_description: LEASE CONTRACT AND SHINY SUV — hand-drawn 2D urban indie cartoon with muted watercolor washes and thin uneven ink, wide 16:9 dealership composition where a gleaming oversized vehicle dominates while a long lease agreement curls from its windshield like a tether, no character visible

shots.text: You answered it with two hundred and forty-one thousand miles,
shots.scene_description: WORN COROLLA ODOMETER — extreme close insert inside the dim older car, digits reading "241000" in Comic Sans MS, dashboard plastic polished by years of use, deliberately composed for wide 16:9, hand-drawn 2D urban indie cartoon with muted earthy watercolor washes, thin uneven ink lines, restrained shading, and textured paper grain
shots.expression: unseen pride carried through accumulated mileage
shots.pose: driver remains outside the tight dashboard frame
shots.action: odometer rests at its hard-earned total
shots.background_mood: quiet proof beneath muted morning light

shots.text: a folder of oil-change receipts,
shots.edit_instruction: THICK SERVICE FOLDER — hand-drawn 2D urban indie cartoon with muted watercolor washes, thin uneven ink, and textured paper rendering — hard cut to an overhead glove-box insert as the compartment hangs open, revealing a dog-eared folder swollen with chronologically layered receipts; sparse headings use Comic Sans MS, same Corolla interior and morning light
shots.expression: unseen patience expressed through careful maintenance
shots.pose: driver remains beyond the overhead insert
shots.action: overfilled folder settles inside the open compartment
shots.background_mood: orderly history inside a weathered machine

shots.text: and fifteen years of being quietly misunderstood
shots.scene_description: HAND-DRAWN 2D URBAN INDIE CARTOON WITH MUTED WATERCOLOR WASHES, THIN UNEVEN INK, AND TEXTURED PAPER GRAIN, Protagonist's established build, posture, and facial features — wearing a weathered ochre field jacket, charcoal work trousers, and scuffed brown boots — medium-wide 16:9 curbside portrait beside the aging Corolla; faded seasonal reflections and layered inspection decals imply fifteen passing years while distant pedestrians glance over without approaching
shots.wardrobe_override: weathered ochre field jacket, charcoal work trousers, and scuffed brown boots
shots.expression: calm endurance beneath a faintly wounded gaze
shots.pose: one hand resting lightly on the roof
shots.action: stands beside the car as years accumulate
shots.background_mood: melancholy street softened by passing seasons

shots.text: by people who were, without knowing it,
shots.edit_instruction: HAND-DRAWN 2D URBAN INDIE CARTOON WITH MUTED WATERCOLOR WASHES, THIN UNEVEN INK, AND TEXTURED PAPER GRAIN, varied faces with distracted eyes and restrained smiles — hard cut to a reverse medium shot through two pristine SUV windows; the polished motorists exchange faintly dismissive glances toward the small Corolla and Protagonist across the curb, maintaining the same street geography
shots.expression: unaware confidence edged with mild condescension
shots.action: glance toward the old Corolla without understanding

shots.text: driving straight toward the exact thing
shots.scene_description: HAND-DRAWN 2D URBAN INDIE CARTOON WITH MUTED WATERCOLOR WASHES, THIN UNEVEN INK, AND TEXTURED PAPER GRAIN, mixed builds and composed posture, distracted eyes behind reflective windshields — sweeping elevated 16:9 roadway view as a line of immaculate vehicles travels toward a canyon of looming dealership lights, curling contract forms, and narrowing lanes, drivers small in the background
shots.wardrobe_override: varied pale business shirts, dark tailored coats, and polished commuter attire
shots.expression: confidence untouched by the danger ahead
shots.action: vehicles converge toward the narrowing financial trap

shots.text: you'd already spent a decade walking away from.

shots.expression: settled resolve without triumph or bitterness

shots.text: Drive safe.

shots.expression: unseen peace carried into the final departure
shots.pose: driver concealed within the receding car
